title: 24. Governing Law
text: This Agreement and any dispute or claim (including non-contractual disputes or claims) arising out of or in connection with it or its subject matter or formation shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the law of England and Wales.

title: 25. Arbitration
text: Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, including any question regarding its existence, validity or termination, shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration under the LCIA Rules. The number of arbitrators shall be three. The seat of arbitration shall be London and the language of the arbitration shall be English.

title: 14. Limitation of Liability
text: Nothing in this Agreement limits or excludes either party's liability for death or personal injury caused by its negligence, or for fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation. Subject to that, neither party shall be liable for any loss of profits, loss of business or any indirect or consequential loss, and each party's total aggregate liability arising under or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed 125% of the Charges paid in the twelve months preceding the claim.

title: 15. Indemnity
text: The Supplier shall indemnify and keep indemnified the Customer against all losses, damages, costs (including reasonable legal fees) and expenses incurred by the Customer as a result of any claim by a third party that the receipt or use of the Services infringes that third party's rights. The Customer shall promptly notify the Supplier of any such claim and allow the Supplier to conduct its defence.

title: 18. Termination for Cause
text: Either party may terminate this Agreement with immediate effect by giving written notice to the other party if the other party commits a material breach which is irremediable or, if remediable, fails to remedy that breach within thirty days of being notified in writing to do so, or if the other party enters administration, liquidation or any arrangement with its creditors.

title: 17. Term
text: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue for an Initial Term of thirty-six months. Thereafter it shall automatically renew for successive Renewal Periods of twelve months each, unless either party gives the other not less than ninety days' written notice of non-renewal before the end of the Initial Term or the then-current Renewal Period.

title: 11. Confidentiality
text: Each party undertakes that it shall not at any time during this Agreement and for a period of five years after its expiry disclose to any person any confidential information concerning the business, affairs, customers, clients or suppliers of the other party, except to its employees, officers and professional advisers who need to know such information for the purpose of performing its obligations and who are bound by equivalent duties of confidence.

title: 20. Force Majeure
text: Neither party shall be in breach of this Agreement nor liable for delay in performing, or failure to perform, any of its obligations if such delay or failure results from events, circumstances or causes beyond its reasonable control. If the period of delay or non-performance continues for eight weeks, the party not affected may terminate this Agreement by giving fourteen days' written notice.

title: 9. Deliverables
text: All rights in the source code, designs and documentation created by the Developer for the Client under this Agreement shall vest in the Client upon creation, and the Developer hereby assigns to the Client absolutely all such rights for their full term. The Developer shall keep such materials confidential until delivery and shall not be entitled to any further payment or fee for the assignment beyond the Charges.

title: 12. Data Protection
text: Both parties shall comply with all applicable requirements of the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. To the extent the Supplier processes personal data on behalf of the Customer, it shall do so only on the documented instructions of the Customer, ensure that its personnel are subject to a duty of confidence, and implement appropriate technical and organisational measures against unauthorised or unlawful processing.

title: 6. Charges and Payment
text: In consideration of the Services the Customer shall pay the Charges set out in Schedule 2. The Supplier shall invoice the Customer monthly in arrears and the Customer shall pay each valid invoice within thirty days of receipt to the bank account nominated by the Supplier. Interest shall accrue on overdue sums at 4% per annum above the Bank of England base rate.

title: 13. Remedies
text: The Seller undertakes that the Goods shall, for a period of twelve months from delivery, conform in all material respects with their description and the Specification, be free from material defects in design, material and workmanship, and be fit for any purpose held out by the Seller. Where the Goods do not so comply, the Seller shall, at its option, repair or replace them or refund the price in full.

title: 16. Damages for Delay
text: If the Contractor fails to achieve Completion by the Completion Date, the Contractor shall pay or allow to the Employer a sum calculated at the rate of £2,500 for every week or part of a week between the Completion Date and the date of actual Completion. The parties agree that such sums represent a genuine pre-estimate of the Employer's loss and that the Employer's other remedies for delay are excluded.

title: 19. Restrictive Covenants
text: The Seller covenants with the Buyer that it shall not, for a period of two years from Completion, in the United Kingdom carry on or be engaged in any business which competes with the Business, nor solicit or entice away from the Company any person who was an employee or customer of the Company during the twelve months before Completion.

title: 28. Assignment
text: Neither party may assign, transfer, mortgage, charge or deal in any other manner with any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed, save that the Customer may assign the benefit of this Agreement to any member of its Group.

title: 30. General
text: If any person or group of persons acting in concert, who did not have such control on the date of this Agreement, acquires control of the Distributor within the meaning of section 1124 of the Corporation Tax Act 2010, the Distributor shall notify the Principal within five Business Days and the Principal may, within sixty days of such notification, end this Agreement on written notice.

title: 31. Notices
text: Any notice given to a party under or in connection with this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be delivered by hand or by pre-paid first-class post at its registered office, or sent by email to the address specified in Schedule 1. A notice delivered by hand is deemed received at the time of delivery; a notice sent by email is deemed received at 9.00 am on the next Business Day.

title: 33. Severance
text: If any provision or part-provision of this Agreement is or becomes invalid, illegal or unenforceable, it shall be deemed modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it valid, legal and enforceable. If such modification is not possible, the relevant provision shall be deemed deleted, without affecting the validity and enforceability of the rest of this Agreement.

title: 32. Communications and Variation
text: This Agreement constitutes the whole agreement between the parties and supersedes all previous drafts, arrangements and understandings between them relating to its subject matter. Each party acknowledges that in entering into this Agreement it does not rely on any statement, representation or assurance that is not set out in this Agreement. No variation shall be effective unless it is in writing and signed by both parties.

title: 21. Insurance
text: During the term of this Agreement and for six years thereafter, the Consultant shall maintain in force with a reputable insurance company professional indemnity insurance in an amount of not less than £5,000,000 for each claim and public liability insurance of not less than £10,000,000, and shall on request produce the policy and the receipt for the current premium.

title: 8. Use of Third Parties
text: The Supplier may not delegate the performance of any part of the Services to any third party without the Customer's prior written consent. Where the Customer consents, the Supplier shall remain fully responsible for all acts and omissions of each such third party as if they were its own and shall procure that every such third party is bound by obligations equivalent to those in this Agreement.

title: 17. Termination
text: This Lease is granted for a period of ten years beginning on and including 25 March 2027. The Tenant shall have the option to extend the period by a further five years by serving written notice on the Landlord not less than twelve months before the expiry date, provided there is no subsisting breach of the Tenant's covenants.

title: 4. Duration
text: The Licensor may end this Licence at any time by written notice with immediate effect if the Licensee fails to pay any amount due within fourteen days of its due date, challenges the validity of the Licensed Patents, or suffers an insolvency event. On such ending all rights granted to the Licensee shall immediately revert to the Licensor.

title: 14A. Liability for Third-Party Claims
text: The Customer shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Provider and its officers from and against any claim brought by a third party arising from content uploaded by the Customer or its Users to the Platform, and shall pay all damages and costs finally awarded against the Provider in respect of such claim, provided the Provider gives prompt notice of the claim.

The Processor shall process the names, contact details and purchase histories of Customer's end users only for the purpose of running the loyalty programme, shall not transfer them outside the United Kingdom or the European Economic Area, shall notify the Controller without undue delay on becoming aware of any breach affecting them, and shall delete them within thirty days after the programme ends.

A party shall not be treated as being in breach to the extent that its performance is prevented or hindered by flood, earthquake, epidemic, war, terrorist attack, riot or governmental action, provided that it promptly informs the other party of the event, uses all reasonable endeavours to mitigate its effect and resumes performance as soon as reasonably possible.

The Supplier shall at its own cost maintain cover with a reputable insurer against loss of or damage to the Customer Materials while they are in its possession, and the Supplier's liability for the Customer Materials shall in no event be limited by the Charges or by any cap on liability in clause 14.

title: 1. Definitions and Interpretation
text: In this Agreement: Business Day means a day other than a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in England; Group means, in relation to a company, that company, any subsidiary or holding company from time to time of that company; clause and Schedule headings shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement; and words in the singular include the plural.

title: Background
text: (A) The Supplier is a provider of cloud-based payroll software. (B) The Customer wishes to obtain, and the Supplier wishes to provide, access to such software and related support services on the terms set out in this Agreement, and the Supplier has submitted its proposal dated 2 February 2026.

title: 36. Counterparts
text: This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which when executed shall constitute a duplicate original, but all the counterparts shall together constitute the one agreement. Transmission of an executed counterpart by email in PDF format shall take effect as delivery of an executed counterpart.
